item.title: The legal strain on Europe’s asylum system
item.description: In July, Greece temporarily suspended processing asylum requests. This created an uproar among various humanitarian organizations, including the United Nations, which criticized the way Greece was handling the rapid influx of asylum seekers. item.title: JFK’s grandson joins competitive congressional field
item.description: Jerry Nadler has represented New York’s 12th District, which encompasses Midtown Manhattan, the Upper East Side and Upper West Side for 17 terms.
